description: Pluggable hook returning governance rules (policies, regulations, contracts, standards) that apply to a (scope_path, topic, context) tuple. Governance is a SEPARATE concept from depth-priority `.ai/instruct.md` resolution — it adds external constraints (laws, contracts, organization policy) on top of the scope authority. The default implementation reads `.ai/governance/`; projects override the resolver to integrate state/regulator/customer rule systems.
checklist: 1. Accept a query: { scope_path, topic, context } where context is a free-form bag (e.g., { region, customer_tier, data_class, jurisdiction })
2. Read `.ai/governance/README.md` to discover the active resolver (default: file-based listing of `.ai/governance/*.md`); if a project-specific resolver is registered, defer to it
3. For the default resolver: load every `.ai/governance/*.md` file, filter by frontmatter `applies_to` (paths/topics/contexts) — return matching files as governance_refs
4. Never collapse governance into the scope's `.ai/instruct.md` — they are returned as a separate list and treated as additive constraints
5. If no governance is registered for the project, return { governance_refs: [], note: 'no governance configured' } — this is valid; depth-priority alone governs
6. Cache results per (scope_path, topic, context) within a single agent run
